name: Alice
source:
The story centers on a brother who helps his sister find a lost item. During their search, they recall shared moments from the past and generally spend time together reliving pleasant memories. 

[translated from [url=https://crocodio.itch.io/alice]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事围绕一位兄弟帮助他的妹妹找到丢失的物品展开。在寻找过程中，他们会回忆起过去的共同时刻，并且通常会花时间一起重温愉快的回忆。

[译自[url=https://crocodio.itch.io/alice]itch.io[/url]]
